cards.name: Funeral Rites
cards.oracle_text: You draw two cards, lose 2 life, then mill two cards.

cards.name: Spread the Sickness
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target creature, then proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

cards.name: Lost Hours
cards.oracle_text: Target player reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player puts that card into their library third from the top.

cards.name: Paramecia Coloniex
cards.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, mill three cards. (Put the top three cards of your library into your graveyard.)
When this creature dies, you may exile it. When you do, put target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.

cards.name: Eyes of the Beholder
cards.oracle_text: Target creature gets -11/-11 until end of turn.

cards.name: Bleed Dry
cards.oracle_text: Target creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.

cards.name: Gravblade Heavy
cards.oracle_text: As long as you control an artifact, this creature gets +1/+0 and has deathtouch.

cards.name: Essence Feed
cards.oracle_text: Target player loses 3 life. You gain 3 life and create three 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens. They have "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}."

cards.name: Priest of the Haunted Edge
cards.oracle_text: {T}, Sacrifice this creature: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of snow lands you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
